card.name: Words after 'not involved' or 'co-author'
card.fires_on: The small word right after 'involved', 'participate', 'co-author' or 'did not sign', usually 'in', 'of', 'both' or 'the', in quotes about who took part in a study.

modes.label: Outside expert comment
modes.description: Preposition after 'was not involved' or 'did not participate' in a quoted expert's description.
modes.example: who was not involved<< in>> the new work.

modes.label: Co-author link
modes.description: Word after 'co-author' naming the papers or statement.
modes.example: co-author on<< both>> articles, says the

modes.label: Not taking part
modes.description: Word after a negated verb of joining or signing.
modes.example: the USA did not sign<< the>> Kyoto protocol

card.writes: It pushes toward words about participating and authors.
card.plain: It marks the little word after phrases saying someone did or did not take part in a study or project.
